messages.subject: Updating tau in dcar_normal
parts:
Hi all,

I was fitting an improper CAR model with a gamma prior for tau and noticed that it was updated using RW Sampler. I'd assumed that tau would show up as a conjugate sampler. A small example code is below (actually the one in the NIMBLE user manual). I would appreciate it if anyone could share any thoughts or ideas. 

> # Improper
> code <- nimbleCode({
+         alpha ~ dflat()
+         beta ~ dnorm(0, 0.0001)
+         tau ~ dgamma(0.001, 0.001)
+         s[1:N] ~ dcar_normal(adj[1:L], weights[1:L], num[1:N], tau, zero_mean = 1)
+         for(i in 1:N) {
+                 log(lambda[i]) <- alpha + beta*x[i] + s[i]
+                 y[i] ~ dpois(lambda[i])
+         }
+ })
>
> L <- 8
> constants <- list(N = 4, L = L, num = c(3, 2, 2, 1), weights = rep(1, L),
+                   adj = c(2,3,4,1,3,1,2,1), x = c(0, 2, 2, 8))
> data <- list(y = c(6, 9, 7, 12))
> inits <- list(alpha = 0, beta = 0, tau = 1, s = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
> Rmodel <- nimbleModel(code, constants, data, inits)
